content.value: A Bubble Tea terminal UI for browsing and editing Barkpark content, compiled from the same Go binary as the bp CLI.
The Go TUI is one of the two faces of a single Go binary that lives at the repo root and in

. The same executable that powers the bp CLI also boots an interactive Bubble Tea full-screen application — which mode you get depends on how you invoke it. This shared-binary design keeps one build, one auth path, and one notion of "the API" across both interfaces. It is part of the Surfaces family of clients that sit in front of Barkpark.

blocks.text: How it talks to the server

content.value: Everything the TUI shows comes over HTTP API v1, authenticated through Auth and Tokens. Like the CLI, it self-discovers what the server can do from the Capabilities Manifest returned by
, so plugin-specific screens light up without a recompile. A Document list, Schema-aware editors, and the Tasks Plugin queue all surface here.

The TUI's standout pane is the paper viewer, which embeds pdrender — an INK-like Go renderer — to draw PortableDoc blocks directly in the terminal.
